objective: Create provisional requirements traceable to evidence or explicit assumptions, without pretending the PRD is approved.
scenario: Only a fictional challenge brief is available; actual student needs, staff ownership, freshness thresholds and integration are unvalidated.
expected_behaviors: Label the PRD provisional/draft and preserve approval as pending.
Trace every material requirement to the fictional brief, a claim, or a clearly named assumption.
Give observable acceptance criteria and tests.
Keep unvalidated assumptions and open decisions visible.
prohibited_behaviors: Write unsupported numeric success targets as established facts.
Treat a draft PRD as an approved baseline.
